title: Qualify safe SQLite reader reuse for overview and history routes that open a connection per request
outcome: An independently decided way to eliminate avoidable per-request read-only open/configuration overhead on the relevant routes while preserving path-redirection rejection, fresh/coherent snapshot semantics, read-only behavior and concurrency isolation, or an explicit defer if equivalence/benefit is unproved. Greg's browser totals remain symptoms, not proof that open time dominates.
acceptance: Record and independently concur the read-route safety/consistency contract with running-source file:line: immediate-parent/main/sidecar redirection preflight and existing error/override boundaries remain effective on each required read boundary; retain READ_ONLY/query_only behavior and existing timeouts. A cached handle is not proof that its current pathname is still safe or still names the same database. Cover replacement, newly created sidecars, changed store/path and shutdown. No live-store read, live request measurement or capture is authorized for this research.

Compare retaining per-request opening, safe reuse of an existing bounded reader owner, and other strictly scoped designs. Specify exclusive connection use (NO_MUTEX is not authority for concurrent sharing), finite resources/backpressure, identity/invalidation, per-request fresh transaction/pin/end, and failure/cleanup. Never cache an open historical read transaction across requests, silently pin the WAL indefinitely, reuse stale prefix/snapshot data or serialize all routes behind a newly global unbounded queue. If path/snapshot equivalence is unproved, defer.

With disposable repository-contained fixtures ONLY and a separately authorized unchanged-input plan, distinguish blocking admission/StateInner wait, path checks, connection/config/BEGIN, blob read/counting, serialization and close cost, plus opaque remainder. Compare resident/nonresident overview and tail; preserve the exact browser facts and mark causal attribution unavailable until actually measured. Small response bytes are not a cost measurement; no live-store or proxy query.

If a design is authorized for implementation, deterministic tests cover path/sidecar replacement/reparse failures, cached-reader invalidation, repeated fresh snapshots across concurrent writes/rollback/eviction, prefix count/conflict behavior, remote/local parity, errors, cancellation/shutdown and finite reader ownership. Existing history cursor/snapshot-pin safety, bucket semantics, assertions, deadlines and test load stay intact; no timeout inflation or retry-until-green.

Relevant focused validation, independent vendor review pair and exact-input maintained full gate precede any implementation landing. Report native/platform and fixture-evidence limits; no claim that a synthetic open reduction proves Greg's live ~1 s delay repaired.
